blocks.text: Low-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum compound ke structure ke baare mein teen ahem maloomat deta hai: molecule mein protons ke kitne mukhtalif environments hain, yeh environments kis qism ke hain, aur har environment mein protons ki nisbati (relative) tadaad kya hai. ¹H NMR spectrum parhte waqt teen cheezein ghaur se dekhi jati hain: spectrum mein peaks ki kul tadaad, har peak ki jagah (chemical shift δ), aur har peak ke neeche ka area.

blocks.title: Peaks ki tadaad
blocks.text: ¹H NMR spectrum mein peaks ki tadaad molecule mein protons ke mukhtalif chemical environments ki tadaad ke barabar hoti hai.
Spectrum ki har peak aik alag chemical environment ko zahir karti hai.

blocks.alt: Low-resolution spectrum: absorption of energy banam delta ppm, 7.0 se 0.0. Teen chaudi peaks: a (1H) taqreeban 5.4, b (2H) taqreeban 3.7, c (3H, sab se lambi) taqreeban 1.2, aur 0.0 par TMS ki chhoti peak. Inset mein ethanol: CH3 ke Hc aur CH2 ke Hb dabbon mein, O-H ka Ha daire (circle) mein.
blocks.caption: Figure 30.4: Ethanol ka low-resolution 1H NMR spectrum (kitab ki Figure 30.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen peaks = teen environments. Peak a (O-H, 5.4 ppm) sab se chhoti, b (CH₂, 3.7 ppm) darmiyani aur c (CH₃, 1.2 ppm) sab se bari hai: areas 1:2:3, jo har group ke protons ki tadaad hai. Structure par dabbon aur daire ke rang peaks ke haroof se milte hain.

Figure 30.4 mein ethanol (CH₃CH₂OH) ka low-resolution ¹H NMR spectrum dikhaya gaya hai. Is mein teen peaks hain, yani ethanol mein protons ke teen mukhtalif environments hain: CH₃ protons, CH₂ protons aur OH proton.

blocks.title: Peak ki chemical shift
blocks.text: Har peak ki chemical shift batati hai ke woh peak dene wale protons ka chemical environment kis qism ka hai.

Environment ki qism chemical shifts ko standard qeematon (Table 30.1) se mila kar pehchani jati hai. Ethanol ke spectrum (Figure 30.4) mein 5.4 ppm wali peak kam electron density wale environment (OH) ki hai. 3.7 ppm wali peak oxygen ke saath jure –CH₂– ki hai, aur 1.2 ppm wala signal methyl group (–CH₃ protons) ka hai.
Har peak ke neeche ka area us peak ko dene wale protons ki tadaad ke mutabiq (proportional) hota hai.

Ethanol ke ¹H NMR spectrum (Figure 30.4) mein peaks par 1H, 2H aur 3H likha hai, yani peaks ke areas 1:2:3 ki nisbat (ratio) mein hain. Yeh har environment ke protons ki tadaad se milta hai: -OH mein 1, –CH₂ mein 2 aur –CH₃ mein 3 protons. Is spectrum se pata chalta hai ke protons ke teen qism ke environments hain, is liye teen signals aate hain, aur intensity ka ratio 1:2:3 hai. Har qism ke protons jorne se molecule ke kul protons milte hain: ethanol mein kul 6 hydrogen atoms (1 + 2 + 3) hain.

blocks.prompt: a) ¹H NMR spectrum mein signals ki tadaad kya batati hai?
blocks.explanation: Molecule mein protons ke mukhtalif chemical environments ki tadaad.

blocks.prompt: b) In molecules ke ¹H NMR spectra mein kitni peaks aayengi? (i) 1,1,2,2-dichloroethane (ii) butane (iii) propan-2-ol (iv) pentan-3-one (v) benzene
blocks.explanation: (i) 1 (neeche 'Kitab ki ghalti' dekhein); (ii) 2 (CH₃ aur CH₂); (iii) 3 (CH₃, CH, OH); (iv) 2 (do aik jaise ethyl groups ke CH₃ aur CH₂); (v) 1.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne ‘1,1,2,2-dichloroethane’ chhapa hai. Yeh naam mumkin nahi: chaar locants (1,1,2,2) ke liye chaar chlorine chahiye, yani 1,1,2,2-tetrachloroethane, Cl₂CH–CHCl₂. Agar 1,2-dichloroethane, ClCH₂–CH₂Cl, muraad tha to bhi jawab aik hi hai: tamam protons barabar (equivalent) hain, sirf aik environment.

blocks.prompt: c) Bromoethane (CH₃-CH₂-Br) ke ¹H NMR spectrum mein kitni peaks aur kin chemical shifts par?
blocks.explanation: Do peaks: Br ke saath CH₂, 3.0 – 4.5 ppm (area 2), aur CH₃, alkyl, 0.5 – 1.5 ppm (area 3).

blocks.prompt: d) 2-chlorobutane ke ¹H NMR spectrum mein kitne signals aayenge? Structure bana kar batayein ke kis hydrogen ki chemical shift sab se zyada hogi.
blocks.explanation: Structure CH₃–CHCl–CH₂–CH₃ hai; chaar environments, is liye chaar signals. C2 par jura akela H, jo chlorine wale carbon par hai, sab se zyada chemical shift (3.0 – 4.5 ppm) dikhayega.

blocks.prompt: e) ¹H NMR mein peak ka area kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Us environment mein protons ki nisbati (relative) tadaad.

items: Peaks ki tadaad = protons ke environments ki tadaad.
Chemical shift = environment ki qism (Table 30.1); area = protons ki nisbati tadaad.
